choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] This cup is yours to drink.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Pray for those who crucify you
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] "Father, forgive them."

legions_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not by Power
legions_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Heaven waits, but love stays nailed.
Forgiveness is the only sword now.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Pray for those who crucify you
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] "They know not what they do."

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not the Father's Way
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] A curse here would unmake the gift.
Only mercy can complete it.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Pray for those who crucify you
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] "Father, forgive them."

mocking.title: [TODO:fr] The Crowd Mocks
mocking.text:
[TODO:fr] "Save yourself! Come down from there!"
Their shouts climb the wood like smoke.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Glory is not won by display.
[TODO:fr] Climbing down undoes salvation.
[TODO:fr] Silence carries the weight of love.

shout_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not by Voice
shout_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Shouting cannot heal their blindness.
Only your stillness can.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You bow your head silently.

climb_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Stay for Love
climb_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] To step down is to abandon them.
Love holds you to the wood.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You remain, and the world is held.

two_thieves.title: [TODO:fr] A Thief Turns
two_thieves.text:
[TODO:fr] One thief jeers. The other whispers,
"Remember me when you come as King."

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Paradise opens for him.
[TODO:fr] No repentant heart is turned away.
[TODO:fr] Mercy never measures the past.

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Mercy Speaks
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] A turning heart must be answered.
Speak the promise of paradise.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] His eyes fill with light.

rebuke_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] No Past Held
rebuke_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] You came to save, not to weigh sin.
Grant him what he asks.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Paradise is promised.

mother_john.title: [TODO:fr] Behold Your Mother
mother_john.text:
[TODO:fr] Mary stands below, John beside her.
Her eyes meet yours through the dust.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Send her away to spare her pain
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Love does not flinch from sorrow.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Give her to John as his mother
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] "Woman, behold your son."

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Cry out blame against the crowd
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Blame cannot carry this hour.

send_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] She Must Stay
send_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] She bore you. She must witness this.
Entrust her to your friend.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Give her to John as his mother
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] "Behold your son."

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not Blame, but Love
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The crowd is not why you are here.
Love is. Care for your mother.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Give her to John as his mother
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] John bows and takes her hand.

darkness.title: [TODO:fr] Darkness Covers the Land
darkness.text:
[TODO:fr] At noon the sun is hidden.
A cold shadow drinks the hill.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The darkness has a purpose.
[TODO:fr] Sin's weight settles on you.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Flee the cross in your spirit
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You will not turn from this hour.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Let the Darkness Come
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The world's sin gathers in this hour.
Receive it without resistance.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You take the weight upon yourself.

flee_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Stay Within Love
flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Even now, do not turn away.
Stay, and the world is healed.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your breath steadies in the dark.

my_god.title: [TODO:fr] A Cry to the Father
my_god.text:
[TODO:fr] The Father feels far. Your soul aches.
What words rise from the dark?

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Trust still binds you to Him.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] "My God, why have You left me?"
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Even the cry is faithful.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Stay silent and clench your jaw
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Even psalms of sorrow are prayer.

accuse_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Cry, Do Not Accuse
accuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The psalm of dereliction is yours.
Pray it as it was written.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] "My God, why have You left me?"
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The cry rises in faith.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Let the Cry Out
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Sorrow shared is sorrow offered.
Let the Father hear your heart.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] "My God, why have You left me?"
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The cry breaks from your lips.

veil_torn.title: [TODO:fr] The Work Is Done
veil_torn.text:
[TODO:fr] Strength fades. Salvation stands fulfilled.
The temple veil waits to be torn.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] From top to bottom, the veil tears.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Beg for one more hour of life
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The hour has come and is enough.
[TODO:fr] Victory whispers; it does not boast.

beg_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] It Is Time
beg_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Every prophecy is now fulfilled.
Speak the word and let it be done.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The veil splits from heaven down.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Quiet Triumph
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] This victory wears a crown of thorns.
Let the finishing word be gentle.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Holy curtain torn in two.

final_breath.title: [TODO:fr] Into Your Hands
final_breath.text:
[TODO:fr] The earth trembles. The light bends low.
One breath remains. What is it?

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Love is the only word now.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Cling to life with all your strength
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Trust opens the hand at last.
[TODO:fr] You bow your head, and breathe out.

curse_end_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] End in Love
curse_end_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] A curse cannot seal this gift.
Give your last breath to the Father.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You surrender all you are.

cling_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Open Your Hands
cling_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] To keep your life is to lose it.
Give it back, and save the world.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your spirit returns to the Father.

ending.title: [TODO:fr] It Is Accomplished
ending.text:
[TODO:fr] The centurion whispers, "Truly,
this was the Son of God."
